title: Etched Valuation Jumps to $50B from $21B August Raise
summary:
The AI chip startup Etched is in early discussions to raise new capital at a valuation that would more than double its most recent pricing, sources told TechCrunch. The firm, which produces inference chips, has received investment offers that value the company at as much as $50B. These offers follow a funding round in August that placed the company's value at $21B.

Etched emerged from stealth mode only three months ago and is currently negotiating a funding range between $40B and $50B. The sudden increase in valuation reflects surging interest from investors seeking exposure to AI inference hardware after the startup's public emergence.
